channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: UK Private Parking Fines to Face New Regulations
item.description: New rules are being introduced in the UK to regulate fines issued by private parking operators. Drivers will be given a five-minute grace period to decide whether to park and an additional ten minutes to leave after their parking session… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: AI poses real threat of bioweapons, intelligence chief warns
item.description: Sir Ken McCallum, head of the UK's MI5 intelligence service, warned in his annual speech that artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to significantly increase the risks associated with existing and new bioweapons. Microsoft's head… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Tourist Found Guilty of Animal Cruelty for Flamingo Theft
item.description: A Canadian tourist has been found guilty of animal cruelty in Las Vegas for stealing a flamingo from a hotel exhibit. The bird, named Peachy, was taken from its display. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ukraine Military Uses Drone to Evacuate Wounded Soldier
item.description: Ukraine's military has used an aerial drone to evacuate a wounded soldier, an operation described as a potential world-first. The drone was deployed to airlift the injured soldier from the battlefield. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Four Soldiers Die in Training Fire at CFB Wainwright
item.description: Four soldiers died in a fire during a military training exercise at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Wainwright. The incident occurred during a training event, and the cause of the fire is under investigation. The province of Saskatchewan is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Protests Erupt in European Cities, Leading to Detentions and Vandalism
item.description: Violent protests swept across multiple European cities over a weekend, resulting in widespread vandalism and looting. Italian police detained nearly 300 people in Milan amidst the unrest, which saw stores damaged. The extent of the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Paris Police Impose Overnight Curfew Amidst Disorder
item.description: Paris police have implemented an overnight curfew in an effort to curb further disorder. The measure involves police patrols on the streets of Paris during the night. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Uber wins UK lawsuit against London black cab drivers
item.description: Uber has successfully had a lawsuit brought by London's black cab drivers thrown out of the High Court. The drivers had claimed Uber misled Transport for London (TfL) over its licensing, seeking damages estimated at £200 million to £340… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Mahmoud Khalil seeks US Supreme Court intervention in detention case
item.description: Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil has asked the U.S. Supreme Court to hear his case, seeking to continue his fight against detention. The legal action involves his efforts to prevent his deportation. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Kenyan Cult Leader Convicted of 191 Murders
item.description: A Kenyan doomsday cult leader has been found guilty of 191 murder charges, including the deaths of 190 children and one adult. The leader was convicted in a trial that a journalist described as a "very painful experience." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Italy Approves Stricter Anti-Riot Laws Following Milan Violence
item.description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has approved new, stricter anti-riot laws in response to recent violence in Milan. The legislation aims to enhance public order measures. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Flight from Tel Aviv Diverts After Bomb Threat, Jets Scramble
item.description: An Austrian Airlines flight traveling from Tel Aviv to Vienna was diverted to Bulgaria on Wednesday following a bomb threat. The aircraft, an Airbus A320, landed safely in Sofia. German newspaper Bild reported that the threat was received… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Christa Pike's execution halted; reports focus on death penalty debate
item.description: Christa Pike's execution was halted after it was reportedly unsuccessful. Reports from various outlets focus on the circumstances surrounding the failed execution and the broader debate on the death penalty. Some coverage highlights Pike's… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: France Imposes Curfews Amidst Weekend Riots
item.description: Following days of rioting, France has introduced localized curfews in areas where required. Authorities are implementing these measures to restore calm after widespread unrest. The curfews are part of a broader crackdown on rioters. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Australian Lawmaker Critically Injured in Vehicle Attack; Man Charged
item.description: An Australian lawmaker is in critical condition after being rammed twice by a vehicle in what police are investigating as a targeted attack. The lawmaker sustained severe injuries, including the loss of a leg. A man has been charged in… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Australian MP Helen Haines Severely Injured in Targeted Vehicle Attack
item.description: Australian Federal Member for Indi, Helen Haines, sustained severe injuries, including the amputation of her leg, after being deliberately struck multiple times by a car outside her Wangaratta office. Police have charged Brendan Nugent in… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: DMK Councillor Booked for Remarks Against CM Vijay
item.description: Chennai police have booked a DMK councillor for allegedly making derogatory and defamatory remarks against Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin at a party event on October 7. The remarks were reportedly made in the presence of senior DMK… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Activist challenges Rs 10,000 peace bond order in Delhi High Court
item.description: Neha Bora, identified as the president of AISA, has challenged a Delhi Police notice ordering her to furnish a Rs 10,000 peace bond. Bora stated that the peace bond is incorrect and has filed a petition in the Delhi High Court against the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Pakistan Army and BLA clash, casualties reported
item.description: The Baloch Liberation Army (BLA) claimed to have conducted 34 operations between October 9 and 20, resulting in the deaths of 23 Pakistani security forces. The BLA stated that those killed included 14 Pakistani army personnel and 9 members… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: YSRCP tells Supreme Court of violence in local body polls
item.description: The YSRCP has informed the Supreme Court that violence and intimidation prevented candidates from filing nominations for local body polls. The party stated that attacks and criminal cases would not force them out of the electoral process. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Gwalior temple crash kills 15, police investigate driver actions
item.description: A truck crashed into a temple in Gwalior, killing 15 people. Police are investigating whether the driver was intoxicated or used a shortcut guided by Google Maps. The incident has also led to suspensions, though the specific officials… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Allahabad High Court stays conviction for 2017 murder case
item.description: The Allahabad High Court has stayed the conviction of an individual who was found guilty in a 2017 murder case. This stay allows the individual to contest elections in Uttar Pradesh in 2027. The court's decision was made in relation to the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Mumbai scrap godown fire leaves two dead, four injured
item.description: A fire broke out at a scrap godown in Mumbai's Sakinaka area on Tuesday evening, resulting in the deaths of two individuals and injuries to four others. The fire, which reached Level-II intensity, engulfed the premises at Abdu Rashid… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Lawmakers Urge FBI Probe into Illinois Hindu Temple Shooting Plot
item.description: Over 100 members of the US Congress have urged the FBI to investigate an attempted mass shooting at a Hindu temple in Illinois as a potential hate crime. The incident involved a self-identified neo-Nazi whose rifle malfunctioned during the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: CBI Takes Over Investigation into Parvinder Singh Jhota Murder Case
item.description: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has initiated an investigation into the murder of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota in Mansa, Punjab. The agency will examine the illegal sale of banned drugs, gather documents from the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Five students leave school, two die in Palghar accident
item.description: In Palghar, Maharashtra, five students who secretly left their ashram school to attend a village fair were involved in a road accident upon their return. The motorcycle they were riding slipped and fell into a roadside ditch, resulting in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: CJP Leaders Challenge Judicial Custody Extension in Delhi High Court
item.description: Leaders of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, approached the Delhi High Court on Tuesday, seeking an urgent hearing to challenge the extension of their judicial custody. They requested a hearing even during… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: CJP moves Delhi High Court for release of Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka
item.description: The organisation Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) has approached the Delhi High Court seeking the release of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, who are in judicial custody. CJP argued before the court that "justice should not be delayed"… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: IIT Bombay student's parents detained during campus protest
item.description: The parents of Sahil Wakode, an IIT Bombay student who died by suicide, were detained by authorities during a protest on the campus. The family is seeking action from the Chief Minister regarding the student's death. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Model Arrested in Shiva Sharma Murder Case in Nagpur
item.description: Model Shraddha Dubey, who was declared a proclaimed offender with a reward of ₹50,000, has been arrested in Nagpur. She was allegedly hiding while wearing a burqa. The arrest was made possible due to a lead related to an e-rickshaw. Dubey… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Student Dies as Stage Frame Collapses During Telangana College Fest
item.description: A student in Telangana died when a lightweight stage frame collapsed during a college festival. The incident occurred during a Dandiya event at an engineering college. One student was killed and another was injured. The frame was described… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Drone strike kills over 150 in disputed Sudan-South Sudan border region
item.description: A drone strike on a market in the disputed Abyei region, located on the border between Sudan and South Sudan, has resulted in the deaths of at least 153 people. The conflict in Sudan, which began in April 2023 between the Sudanese military… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Kashmiri Travellers Alarmed by Bus Attacks in Haryana and Punjab
item.description: Two separate incidents involving attacks on buses carrying Kashmiri travellers have caused alarm. In Haryana, an elderly Kashmiri man was injured when bricks were hurled at a Delhi-Srinagar bus. Subsequently, a similar incident occurred… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Manipur Violence: Three Dead, Protesters Bring Bodies to CM's Residence
item.description: Renewed violence in Manipur has resulted in three deaths, with protesters bringing the bodies to the Chief Minister's residence to demand action. The incident has sparked protests outside the CM's house. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Railways Warn Passengers Against Loud Music, Potential Jail Time
item.description: Indian Railways has issued a warning to passengers against playing loud music or making loud calls on trains, stating that violations could lead to legal action, including a potential jail term of up to six months and a fine of Rs 1,000… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Two Indian nationals charged in US election fraud case
item.description: Two Indian nationals have been charged in connection with election fraud in California, United States. They are among a total of 28 individuals, all green card holders, who have been charged in the case. The charges were announced by the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Annamalai Criticizes Delhi Police Over CJP Leaders' Detention
item.description: Former Tamil Nadu BJP president K. Annamalai has criticized the Delhi Police, stating their actions against CJP leaders constituted a "real disservice." He defended the organization's democratic right to raise critical questions and backed… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann allegedly detained at Delhi airport, fined
item.description: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) alleged that Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was detained for three hours at Delhi airport upon his return from Paris and was subsequently fined ₹50,000. According to AAP's claims, the officials who carried… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Financial Influencer V Harish Dies by Suicide in Chennai
item.description: Financial influencer V Harish, aged 27 and known online as Finance With Harish, died by suicide at his Chennai home on Monday night, October 19, 2026. His father has alleged cyberbullying and harassment as causes, specifically naming Jason… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Government Warns of Deepfake Scams Using PM Modi's Image
item.description: India's cybercrime units have flagged an increase in fraudulent activities using deepfake videos that impersonate Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. These fake videos are being used to promote fraudulent… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.
